eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 单二进制

headline.zh:
Agent 拉依赖、跑脚本时
先问过你再动手
headline.en:
Before your agent runs an install
or a script, it asks you first

sub.zh: 给编码 Agent 一道运行时护栏：每次拉依赖、发网络请求，都会按动作征求你的授权；常见的包管理器和抓取命令（npm/pip/curl 等）会被拦下问一句，再由你点头放行。而不是全有或全无地把 Agent 放出去。
sub.en: Give your coding Agent a runtime guardrail: every dependency install and network request asks for your authorization per action, and common package managers and fetchers (npm/pip/curl …) are intercepted for a prompt before they run. Not all-or-nothing access for your Agent.

hero.command: agentgate run -- claude "add a chart library and wire it up"

body.zh: Agent 决定装某个依赖时，AgentGate 把它拦下来，告诉你它想装什么、为什么，再由你点头放行。装一个被污染的包，不会在 72 个仓库被锁之后才发现。
body.en: When the agent decides to install a dependency, AgentGate pauses it, shows what it wants to install and why, and waits for your okay. A poisoned package is caught at execution, not after 72 repos are disabled.

title.zh: 不该发的外发，挡在门口

body.zh: 一个被装进来的依赖想往没声明过的主机回连或外发数据？AgentGate 在它出门之前就挡住，并写进审计。你声明过哪些注册源，就只放行哪些。
body.en: A dependency that phones home or exfiltrates to a host you never declared? AgentGate blocks it before it leaves and writes it to the audit. Only the registries you list get out.

title.zh: 你点过头的，看得见也收得回
title.en: Your grants are visible and revocable

body.zh: 选过「总是允许」的规则会积起来。一条命令看清现在到底放行了什么，再一条命令把放太宽的撤回——给错的授权，和给出去一样容易收回。规则写入是原子的：就算写到一半被强杀断电，下次启动也不会因为半截坏文件起不来。
body.en: The "always allow" rules you grant pile up. One command shows exactly what you've green-lit; another revokes what got too loose — taking back a bad grant is as easy as giving it. Rule writes are atomic, so even a crash mid-write never leaves a half-file that blocks the next launch.

headline.zh: 让 Agent 自主跑，主机底线你守
headline.en: Let the agent run free — you hold the host line

sub.zh: MIT 开源 · 单二进制 · Linux + macOS
sub.en: MIT open source · single binary · Linux + macOS
